The Calder & Wynne engagement letter is addressed to Petra Voss, General Counsel, Voss-Lindqvist AB [1].

The letter is addressed to Petra Voss in her capacity as General Counsel for Voss-Lindqvist AB.

evidence.quote: To: Petra Voss, General Counsel, Voss-Lindqvist AB — 5 February 2026

items.question: On what date was the service credit side letter signed?
items.answer: The service credit side letter was signed on 28 March 2026. This is stated in the document itself, which notes that the letter is dated 28 March 2026 and that it was signed for Harrowgate Systems Inc. and agreed by Voss-Lindqvist AB on that date [1][2].

evidence.quote: Dated 28 March 2026
Signed for Harrowgate Systems Inc. and agreed by Voss-Lindqvist AB on 28 March 2026 (fictional)

items.question: How much of Harrowgate is Pellucid Holdings acquiring?
items.answer: The documents do not specify the percentage of Harrowgate that Pellucid Holdings is acquiring. They only state that Pellucid Holdings plc has agreed to acquire all of the shares of Harrowgate Systems Inc. [1].

evidence.quote: Pellucid Holdings plc has agreed to acquire all of the shares of Harrowgate Systems Inc.

items.question: Under which clause of the MSA was the change of control notice given?
items.answer: The change of control notice was given under Clause 14.2 of the Harrowgate MSA. The notice states, "We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc." [2].

evidence.quote: We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc.

items.question: Does the Kestrel storage agreement have a fixed end date?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage agreement does not have a fixed end date. The original agreement states that it "continues until terminated" [1].

An amendment to the agreement confirms that all other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force [2], which includes the lack of a fixed end date.

evidence.quote: This Agreement continues until terminated
All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: Which terms of the storage agreement remain in force after Amendment No. 1?
items.answer:
The term "Storage Services Agreement" in Amendment No. 1 states that all other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force [1].

The original Kestrel Storage Services Agreement includes terms such as the provision of storage services, fees, and the term and termination clause. The storage fee was originally set at EUR 4,000 per month [3]. This was amended to EUR 4,600 per month in Amendment No. 1 [7].

The term of the original Storage Services Agreement was stated to continue until terminated [3]. Amendment No. 1 specifies that the amendment takes effect on 1 June 2026 [8].

evidence.quote: 2.2 All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force.
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

evidence.quote: 3.1 Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000, invoiced on the first business day of each month.
1.1 Clause 3.1 of the Storage Services Agreement is deleted and replaced with: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month.
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

evidence.quote: 5.1 This Agreement continues until terminated.
2.1 This Amendment takes effect on 1 June 2026.

items.question: How sure is Jonas Ekberg of the time the alarm sounded?
items.answer: The documents state that Jonas Ekberg recalled the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026, but he was not sure of the exact minute [1].

evidence.quote: I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026. I am not sure of the exact minute.

items.question: What was the Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1?
items.answer: The Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1 was EUR 4,000, as stated in the original Storage Services Agreement [2].
